title: AWS DataSync agents, locations, and tasks
hook: AWS DataSync moves data between on-premises storage, other clouds, and Amazon S3 over a secure connection. A lightweight agent on your network plus source and destination locations and a task definition orchestrate verified bulk and incremental transfers.

blocks.text: DataSync agent is a VM deployed on-premises or in cloud connecting to NFS, SMB, HDFS, object storage, or S3. A location defines source or destination endpoint. A task runs a transfer with options: bandwidth limit, schedule, verify mode, overwrite behavior. Task execution reports bytes transferred, files skipped, and verification status.

entries.plainDefinition: VM appliance bridging on-prem storage to AWS.
entries.example: VMware agent VM with NFS mount to file server.
NFS → S3 nightly at 2 AM UTC.

blocks.text: Datacenter exit timelines depend on transfer throughput and verification. Misconfigured agent networking blocks HTTPS to AWS. Bandwidth throttle too low misses cutover date; too high saturates production NFS. Senior architects compare DataSync versus Snowball versus S3 sync CLI for each migration phase.

blocks.title: Interview framing
blocks.body: Say: agent + locations + task. Throttle bandwidth. Incremental until cutover. Verify checksums. IAM task role scoped to prefix.

diagram.title: DataSync architecture
diagram.source:
flowchart LR
  NFS[On-prem NFS] --> AG[DataSync agent]
  AG -->|TLS| DS[DataSync service]
  DS --> S3[(S3 bucket)]
  DS --> CW[CloudWatch task metrics]

snippet.label: CLI — create S3 location and NFS task
snippet.code:
S3_LOC=$(aws datasync create-location-s3 \
  --s3-bucket-arn arn:aws:s3:::migration-landing \
  --s3-config '{"BucketAccessRoleArn":"arn:aws:iam::123:role/DataSyncS3Access"}' \
  --subdirectory /prod-data/ \
  --query 'LocationArn' --output text)

NFS_LOC=$(aws datasync create-location-nfs \
  --subdirectory /export/prod \
  --on-prem-config AgentArns=arn:aws:datasync:us-east-1:123:agent/agent-abc \
  --server-hostname nfs.corp.example.com \
  --query 'LocationArn' --output text)

aws datasync create-task \
  --source-location-arn "$NFS_LOC" \
  --destination-location-arn "$S3_LOC" \
  --options '{"VerifyMode":"POINT_IN_TIME_CONSISTENT","BandwidthLimit":50000000}'
snippet.explanation: BandwidthLimit in bytes/sec — 50 MB/s throttle. Task role needs s3:PutObject on prefix.

snippet.label: CLI — start task and monitor execution
snippet.code:
EXEC_ARN=$(aws datasync start-task-execution \
  --task-arn arn:aws:datasync:us-east-1:123:task/task-abc \
  --query 'TaskExecutionArn' --output text)

aws datasync describe-task-execution \
  --task-execution-arn "$EXEC_ARN" \
  --query '{Status:Status,BytesTransferred:BytesTransferred,FilesTransferred:FilesTransferred}'
snippet.explanation: Poll until SUCCESS or ERROR. ERROR details in Result with specific failure cause.

snippet.label: CloudFormation — scheduled DataSync task
snippet.code:
Resources:
  MigrationTask:
    Type: AWS::DataSync::Task
    Properties:
      SourceLocationArn: !Ref NfsLocation
      DestinationLocationArn: !Ref S3Location
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
      Options:
        VerifyMode: ONLY_FILES_TRANSFERRED
        OverwriteMode: ALWAYS
        BandwidthLimit: 104857600
snippet.explanation: Nightly 2 AM cron. 100 MB/s bandwidth. ALWAYS overwrite for incremental sync of changed files.

snippet.label: CLI — check agent connectivity
snippet.explanation: Status must be ONLINE before task start. OFFLINE usually firewall blocking HTTPS outbound.

blocks.title: DataSync vs aws s3 sync
rows: Requires mounted path or S3 only

blocks.title: Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: Agent blocked by firewall — no outbound 443. Task role with s3:* on entire bucket. No bandwidth limit — production NFS melts. Skipping verification on compliance migration.

blocks.text: How to prove it in production: CloudWatch BytesTransferred metric vs source size estimate. Task report JSON in CloudWatch Logs. Compare DataSync task duration to link bandwidth formula: bytes / throttle. Snowball when link < effective 100 Mbps and deadline tight.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Saying 'rsync to S3 from laptop.' Strong answer: DataSync agent for verified scalable transfer with bandwidth control and scheduling.

interviewTakeaways: DataSync = agent + source location + destination location + task.
Throttle bandwidth; schedule incremental; verify checksums on compliance migrations.
Task IAM role scoped to S3 prefix; agent needs outbound HTTPS.
60s: Agent NFS to S3 task. Bandwidth limit. Incremental schedule. Verify mode. Snowball if link too slow.
Follow-up: DataSync versus S3 Batch Replication for backlog?
commonPitfalls: Agent firewall blocked — task never starts.
Strong answer: verify agent ONLINE and outbound 443 before cutover weekend.
Task role over-permissioned on entire bucket.

jsTsCorrelations.note: Multipart S3 upload with progress callback is client-side analogy — DataSync handles parallel chunking and resume at infrastructure level.
DataSync incremental task resembles rsync delta sync — only changed files transferred on subsequent runs.
